full_details: Sly and Phillips worked the street fight for tomorrow, when Tybalt begins. Sincler asked for a starved apothecary and twopence saved in padding. Edith moved a hook Sam could not reach. That is not the fastening on Nick's hand. Burbage said five words were too few to die on. You did not answer him. The afternoon was Egeon again. By candle you looked at the first words of tomorrow's play and did not copy a speech past the line you already had. At 22:40 he called from Holywell. You refused ten lines and you refused six. The end stays five words, which you still did not print. If the boy's voice goes, she wakes hoarse, and Dick holds him as he did on Wednesday.
one_sentence: You held the five words through rehearsal and dinner, and at half past ten you told him no.
title: Told Burbage no on the longer death
